annotations.title: Buy a LIGHTHOUSE plan with crypto

description: Create an order for a LIGHTHOUSE plan paid in crypto. payment_method=usdt_trc20 (default): returns the Tron address and the exact USDT amount (unique cents identify the order), valid 60 minutes; after sending, call submit_payment with the tx hash, then get_order returns the API key. payment_method=x402: returns x402 v2 PaymentRequired (USDC on Base); retry the same call with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"] and the API key is returned immediately. Without sign-in the key is not linked to an account; extend=true requires sign-in; monitoring needs the key to be linked to an account. Never send funds without the user's explicit approval.

extend.description: Extend the signed-in user's existing API key instead of issuing a new one.

lang.description: Language of texts in the result. Default: Russian unless the client prefers English.

plan.description: api30: 30 days, api365: 1 year. Both include an API key, dashboard, webhooks and monitoring of up to 10 addresses (monitoring needs sign-in).
